journey: Malicious net_policy — isolation is server-authoritative; a forged policy buys nothing

narrative.step: POSITIVE CONTROL — a legitimate isolated policy (deny-all) is admitted → HELD
ATTACK — a permissive "open" policy is rejected at admission (400, no egress bought)
narrative.assertion: net_policy "open" → 400 invalid (check-exec accepts only the isolated set)

narrative.step: ATTACK — even naming the runner egress sentinel ("egress-runner") on a check lease is rejected (400)
narrative.assertion: net_policy "egress-runner" on a check lease → 400 (isolation is spec-derived, not string-derived — C2)

artifact.gap: The server-side FORCING (overwrite to egress-runner/egress-agent) that ignores the caller value is the runner/agent-mode acquire (req.runner/req.agent); the frozen check-exec acquire cannot reach that path — it instead REJECTS any non-isolated value.
artifact.reachableFrom: runner/agent-mode acquire (needs the runner/agent request fields), not the frozen check-exec acquire verb.
